meta.name: baoyu-youtube-transcript
meta.description: Downloads YouTube video transcripts/subtitles and cover images by URL or video ID. Supports multiple languages, translation, chapters, and speaker identification. Caches raw data for fast re-formatting. Use when user asks to "get YouTube transcript", "download subtitles", "get captions", "YouTube字幕", "YouTube封面", "视频封面", "video thumbnail", "video cover image", or provides a YouTube URL and wants the transcript/subtitle text or cover image extracted.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 下载YouTube视频字幕和封面图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从YouTube视频获取字幕或封面图片
copy.tagline_en: Download YouTube video transcripts and cover images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to get subtitles or cover images from YouTube videos

howto.what: 当你提供 YouTube 链接或视频 ID 时，Claude 会运行脚本，获取该视频的字幕/文字记录和封面图，支持多语言、翻译、章节等输出方式，并缓存原始数据以免重复下载。
howto.when: 当用户说“获取字幕”“下载字幕”“视频封面”等，或发来 YouTube 链接并要求提取文字记录/封面时触发。

say.text: 帮我下载这个视频的字幕：https://youtu.be/abc
say.note: 会生成带时间戳的 Markdown 文字记录。

say.text: 把这个视频的字幕翻译成中文
say.note: 先获取原字幕，再输出翻译后的文本。

say.text: 查一下这个视频有哪些可用字幕
say.note: 会先列出可用语言，不生成转录文本。

howto.what_en: Given a YouTube URL or video ID, Claude runs a script to fetch the video's transcript/subtitles and cover image. It can format output with language selection, timestamped paragraphs, or translation, and caches raw data for faster reuse.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a YouTube transcript, subtitles, or cover image (or similar), or provides a YouTube URL and wants the transcript/cover extracted.

say_en.text: Translate this video's subtitles into Chinese.
say_en.note: Fetches the original transcript, then outputs the translated text.

say_en.text: List the available subtitles for this video.
say_en.note: Shows language options without saving a transcript.
